report.title: Coupon makes my total go UP
report.body:
tried the SAVE10 code from the newsletter. I had 2 things in my cart (coffee beans and a mug, total showed $20.00), typed SAVE10 in the coupon box and hit "Apply coupon". It says "Coupon SAVE10 applied." but the total is now $30.00?? It should be $10 off, so $10.

Seems fine if there's only 1 item in the cart. Chrome on mac.

app_label: Corner Shop, a small online coffee-gear store with a cart and coupon codes

preconditions: the cart contains two items: coffee beans and a mug
steps: Add the coffee beans to the cart
Add the mug to the cart
Type SAVE10 in the coupon box
plan.expected: after applying SAVE10 the cart total shows $10.00
plan.reported_actual: The message "Coupon SAVE10 applied." is shown but the total increases to $30.00 instead of decreasing to $10.00
missing: assumed: the cart page is reached by opening the cart from the site navigation, since the report does not give a path
assumed: the coffee beans and mug are added from the store's product listing, and together they total $20.00
What are the individual prices of the coffee beans and the mug?
Is the SAVE10 code a flat $10 off or a percentage discount? The reporter expects $10 off a $20.00 total
Does the coupon work as expected with only one item in the cart? The reporter says it seems fine, but gave no details
Were the quantities of each item 1?
plan.summary: Applying coupon SAVE10 to a 2-item $20.00 cart raises the total to $30.00 instead of lowering it

# Coupon makes my total go UP

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:4100/.
Stay on localhost:4100 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Before the main steps, make sure of this: the cart contains two items: coffee beans and a mug; the cart total shows $20.00.
Do these in order:
1. Add the coffee beans to the cart
2. Add the mug to the cart
3. Open the cart
4. Type SAVE10 in the coupon box
5. Click the "Apply coupon" button
The reporter says the correct behavior is that after applying SAVE10 the cart total shows $10.00. Verify that after applying SAVE10 the cart total shows $10.00.

verdict.headline: Applying SAVE10 reports success but changes the $20.00 cart total to $30.00 instead of $10.00.
verdict.root_cause: The coupon is accepted, but the cart calculates the discount in the wrong direction or amount.
verdict.suggested_fix: Fix the SAVE10 discount calculation so that a $20.00 cart displays a $10.00 total after the coupon is applied.

fixes.rationale: applyCoupon set the discount to -10 when the cart had more than one item, and total is computed as subtotal minus discount, so the coupon added $10. Always using a +10 discount fixes it.
